name: Garen
description: Strike: Rally. When I've struck twice, level up.
flavorText: The unyielding vanguard of Demacia stands resolute against the darkness.

name: Lux
description: When allied spells cost 6+ total, create a Final Spark in hand.
flavorText: From the light within, she draws her power and her purpose.

name: Vanguard Sergeant
description: When I'm summoned, create a For Demacia! in hand.
flavorText: Rally to me, soldiers! For the king and the realm!

name: Prismatic Barrier
description: Give an ally Barrier this round.
flavorText: The shield shimmers with the light of a thousand stars.

name: Darius
description: When the enemy Nexus is at 10 or less health, level up.
flavorText: They will kneel, or they will be crushed.

name: Reckless Trifarian
description: I can't block.
flavorText: Hesitation is the only true enemy on the battlefield.

name: Noxian Guillotine
description: Kill a damaged unit. If it dies, create a Noxian Guillotine in hand.
flavorText: The axe falls once. If needed, it falls again.

name: Zed
description: Attack: Summon a Living Shadow with my stats.
flavorText: The shadow is the true self, unshackled from weakness.

name: Shadow Assassin
description: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
flavorText: Moving without sound, striking without warning.

name: Deny
description: Stop a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill.
flavorText: The wind answers to no one but itself.

name: Thresh
description: When allies die, store their souls. At 6 souls, level up.
flavorText: Come closer. I shall free your soul from its mortal prison.

name: Warden's Prey
description: Last Breath: Create a random 1 cost follower in hand.
flavorText: Even in death, the Isles yield their dark gifts.

name: Grasp of the Undying
description: Drain 3 from an enemy unit.
flavorText: Life fades. The Isles endure.

name: Grand Plaza
description: When an ally is summoned, give it +1|+0 and Challenger this round.
flavorText: Where heroes are forged and legends begin.

name: Noxkraya Arena
description: Round End: Your strongest ally and the weakest enemy strike each other.
flavorText: In the arena, strength is the only law.

name: Ashe
description: Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy. When you've Frostbitten 5 enemies, level up.
flavorText: The cold does not forgive, and neither does the Warmother.

name: Avarosan Hearthguard
description: When I'm summoned, give all allies in your deck +1|+1.
flavorText: The hearthguard carries the warmth of home into every battle.

name: Flash Freeze
description: Frostbite an enemy.
flavorText: A single breath of the Freljord can halt any advance.

name: Spectral Rider
description: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 if an ally died this round.
flavorText: The rider emerges from the mist, seeking souls owed to the Isles.

name: Spirit Fire
description: Give all enemies -2|-0 this round, then deal 1 to all enemies.
flavorText: The spirits hunger, and the fire answers.

name: Shen
description: Support: Give my supported ally Barrier.
flavorText: Balance in all things. The blade protects as it strikes.

name: Rivershaper
description: When I Strike, draw 1.
flavorText: She reads the river like a scroll, and its currents obey.

name: Howling Abyss
description: Round Start: Create a random champion in hand. It costs 0.
flavorText: At the edge of the world, even gods fall silent.

name: Omen Hawk
description: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
flavorText: It circles once, then dives. The hunt begins.

name: Trifarian Gloryseeker
description: I can't block.
flavorText: Glory is earned in blood, never in retreat.
